Expedia, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json: the --<theme>__<role> literal palettes and the --egds-* semantic roles Expedia's EGDS/UITK stylesheets declare, plus the --spacing__*, --sizing__*, --corner_radius__*, --elevation__*, --duration__* and --easing__* scales and the --egds-type-style-* type system. Each token's exact provenance is in the tables' Source column.

expedia.com answers automation with a 429 "Bot or Not?" wall, so the DOM was a Wayback snapshot of the public home and hotel-search pages served locally, painted with Expedia's live travel-assets.com CSS and fonts — read on 2026-11-13/14, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 (mobile at 390 x 844). The pages pin data-theme-light="light-1"; the theme selector swaps in the other declared themes (dark-1, dark-2, marketing-3 — the promo band's own theme — and the yellow bright-1). Centra No2 and Reckless XPD are commercial and not loaded: text falls back to Inter, display to Source Serif 4. Component mock-ups are drawn with the tokens; the real components are the crops in components.md.

Palette

The literal role palettes every EGDS theme binds: 57 colours each (primary/secondary/tertiary, containers and variants, on- colours, surfaces at three elevations, outline, scrim/shadow, the status set). light1 is the signed-out page theme; marketing3 the pale-blue promo band; bright1 the yellow campaign palette; loyalty.* the eight One Key tiers.

Roles

The egds.* semantic layer the components actually read, resolved on the selected theme; aliases point at the palette token holding the same value.

TokenValueSource

Typography

Three EGDS type styles: display in Reckless XPD (the hero serif), headline and text in Centra No2. Each is a family + weight plus per-size size/line-height/tracking; the composites below compose them.

Type pieces and the older scales

TokenValueSource

Space and shape

Spacing

The --spacing__* step scale; the --egds-spacing-* semantic names alias into it (spacing.medium = 1rem, large 1.5rem, extra-large 2rem).

Sizing

Radius

The --corner_radius__* scale: fields take 8px (2x), cards and dialogs 16px (4x), buttons and pills the 10000x full round.

Opacity

TokenValueSource

Elevation

The --elevation__* box-shadow steps and the component-level shadows.

Motion

The --duration__* steps, the --easing__* curves and the --egds-movement-*/--egds-appearance-* presets (a duration plus a curve).

Component variables

The --<component>__* variables EGDS declares per component, resolved on :root — one group per component, inside collapsible tables.

Focus

Keyboard focus draws a 1px #101010 outline on most controls and a heavier ring on the primary buttons (measured measured.focus.*).

Searchprimary button: 1px #101010 outline, offset 2px
Sort by recommended ⌄pill: 1px outline, offset 0
Where to?field: 1px outline, offset 1px

Layout

Read on the home page at 1440 x 900 (raw/layout.json). A 72px global header; the content column is 1248px centred (96px margins); the search card is 1200 x 252 with three 344px fields and the 83px Search button; marketing bands and deal carousels tile below.

header 1440 x 72 — logo · Shop travel · USD · List · Support · Trips · bell · Sign in
hero photo + Reckless XPD display title
search card 1200 x 252 — tabs · Where to? 344 | Dates 344 | Travelers 344 | Search 83
marketing-3 promo band
deal card ~270
save heart over photo
carousel, chevron nav
footer link columns

On the results page the column splits ~236px filter rail + 756px cards; the compact search form repeats the three fields inline at 1016 x 48. On a phone (390) the card stacks and fields go full width.
